texts.eph.2.6: и воскресил с Ним, и посадил на небесах во Христе Иисусе,
texts.eph.2.7: дабы явить в грядущих веках преизобильное богатство благодати Своей в благости к нам во Христе Иисусе.
texts.eph.2.8: Ибо благодатью вы спасены через веру, и сие не от вас, Божий дар:
texts.eph.2.9: не от дел, чтобы никто не хвалился.
texts.eph.2.10: Ибо мы — Его творение, созданы во Христе Иисусе на добрые дела, которые Бог предназначил нам исполнять.
texts.eph.2.11: Итак помните, что вы, некогда язычники по плоти, которых называли необрезанными так называемые обрезанные плотским обрезанием, совершаемым руками,
texts.eph.2.12: что вы были в то время без Христа, отчуждены от общества Израильского, чужды заветов обетования, не имели надежды и были безбожники в мире.
texts.eph.2.13: А теперь во Христе Иисусе вы, бывшие некогда далеко, стали близки Кровию Христовою.
texts.eph.2.14: Ибо Он есть мир наш, соделавший из обоих одно и разрушивший стоявшую посреди преграду,
texts.eph.2.15: упразднив вражду Плотию Своею, а закон заповедей учением, дабы из двух создать в Себе Самом одного нового человека, устрояя мир,
texts.eph.2.16: и в одном теле примирить обоих с Богом посредством креста, убив вражду на нем.
texts.eph.2.17: И, придя, благовествовал мир вам, дальним и близким,
texts.eph.2.18: потому что через Него и те и другие имеем доступ к Отцу, в одном Духе.
texts.eph.2.19: Итак вы уже не чужие и не пришельцы, но сограждане святым и свои Богу,
texts.eph.2.20: быв утверждены на основании Апостолов и пророков, имея Самого Иисуса Христа краеугольным камнем,
texts.eph.2.21: на котором все здание, слагаясь стройно, возрастает в святый храм в Господе,
texts.eph.2.22: на котором и вы устрояетесь в жилище Божие Духом.
texts.eph.3.1: Для сего-то я, Павел, сделался узником Иисуса Христа за вас язычников.
texts.eph.3.2: Как вы слышали о домостроительстве благодати Божией, данной мне для вас,
texts.eph.3.3: потому что мне через откровение возвещена тайна (о чем я и выше писал кратко),
texts.eph.3.4: то вы, читая, можете усмотреть мое разумение тайны Христовой,
texts.eph.3.5: которая не была возвещена прежним поколениям сынов человеческих, как ныне открыта святым Апостолам Его и пророкам Духом Святым,
texts.eph.3.6: чтобы и язычникам быть сонаследниками, составляющими одно тело, и сопричастниками обетования Его во Христе Иисусе посредством благовествования,
texts.eph.3.7: которого служителем сделался я по дару благодати Божией, данной мне действием силы Его.
texts.eph.3.8: Мне, наименьшему из всех святых, дана благодать сия — благовествовать язычникам неисследимое богатство Христово
texts.eph.3.9: и открыть всем, в чем состоит домостроительство тайны, сокрывавшейся от вечности в Боге, создавшем все Иисусом Христом,
texts.eph.3.10: дабы ныне соделалась известною через Церковь начальствам и властям на небесах многоразличная премудрость Божия,
texts.eph.3.11: по предвечному определению, которое Он исполнил во Христе Иисусе, Господе нашем,
texts.eph.3.12: в Котором мы имеем дерзновение и надежный доступ через веру в Него.
texts.eph.3.13: Посему прошу вас не унывать при моих ради вас скорбях, которые суть ваша слава.
texts.eph.3.14: Для сего преклоняю колени мои пред Отцем Господа нашего Иисуса Христа,
texts.eph.3.15: от Которого именуется всякое отечество на небесах и на земле,
texts.eph.3.16: да даст вам, по богатству славы Своей, крепко утвердиться Духом Его во внутреннем человеке,
texts.eph.3.17: верою вселиться Христу в сердца ваши,
texts.eph.3.18: чтобы вы, укорененные и утвержденные в любви, могли постигнуть со всеми святыми, что широта и долгота, и глубина и высота,
texts.eph.3.19: и уразуметь превосходящую разумение любовь Христову, дабы вам исполниться всею полнотою Божиею.
texts.eph.3.20: А Тому, Кто действующею в нас силою может сделать несравненно больше всего, чего мы просим, или о чем помышляем,
texts.eph.3.21: Тому слава в Церкви во Христе Иисусе во все роды, от века до века. Аминь.
texts.eph.4.1: Итак я, узник в Господе, умоляю вас поступать достойно звания, в которое вы призваны,
texts.eph.4.2: со всяким смиренномудрием и кротостью и долготерпением, снисходя друг ко другу любовью,
texts.eph.4.3: стараясь сохранять единство духа в союзе мира.
texts.eph.4.4: Одно тело и один дух, как вы и призваны к одной надежде вашего звания;
texts.eph.4.5: один Господь, одна вера, одно крещение,
texts.eph.4.6: один Бог и Отец всех, Который над всеми, и через всех, и во всех нас.
texts.eph.4.7: Каждому же из нас дана благодать по мере дара Христова.
texts.eph.4.8: Посему и сказано: восшед на высоту, пленил плен и дал дары человекам.
texts.eph.4.9: А "восшел" что означает, как не то, что Он и нисходил прежде в преисподние места земли?
texts.eph.4.10: Нисшедший, Он же есть и восшедший превыше всех небес, дабы наполнить все.
texts.eph.4.11: И Он поставил одних Апостолами, других пророками, иных Евангелистами, иных пастырями и учителями,
texts.eph.4.12: к совершению святых, на дело служения, для созидания Тела Христова,
texts.eph.4.13: доколе все придем в единство веры и познания Сына Божия, в мужа совершенного, в меру полного возраста Христова;
texts.eph.4.14: дабы мы не были более младенцами, колеблющимися и увлекающимися всяким ветром учения, по лукавству человеков, по хитрому искусству обольщения,
texts.eph.4.15: но истинною любовью все возращали в Того, Который есть глава Христос,
texts.eph.4.16: из Которого все тело, составляемое и совокупляемое посредством всяких взаимно скрепляющих связей, при действии в свою меру каждого члена, получает приращение для созидания самого себя в любви.
texts.eph.4.17: Посему я говорю и заклинаю Господом, чтобы вы более не поступали, как поступают прочие народы, по суетности ума своего,
texts.eph.4.18: будучи помрачены в разуме, отчуждены от жизни Божией, по причине их невежества и ожесточения сердца их.
texts.eph.4.19: Они, дойдя до бесчувствия, предались распутству так, что делают всякую нечистоту с ненасытимостью.
texts.eph.4.20: Но вы не так познали Христа;
texts.eph.4.21: потому что вы слышали о Нем и в Нем научились, — так как истина во Иисусе, —
texts.eph.4.22: отложить прежний образ жизни ветхого человека, истлевающего в обольстительных похотях,
texts.eph.4.24: и облечься в нового человека, созданного по Богу, в праведности и святости истины.
texts.eph.4.25: Посему, отвергнув ложь, говорите истину каждый ближнему своему, потому что мы члены друг другу.
texts.eph.4.26: Гневаясь, не согрешайте: солнце да не зайдет во гневе вашем;
texts.eph.4.28: Кто крал, вперед не кради, а лучше трудись, делая своими руками полезное, чтобы было из чего уделять нуждающемуся.
texts.eph.4.29: Никакое гнилое слово да не исходит из уст ваших, а только доброе для назидания в вере, дабы оно доставляло благодать слушающим.
texts.eph.4.30: И не оскорбляйте Святаго Духа Божия, Которым вы запечатлены в день искупления.
texts.eph.4.31: Всякое раздражение и ярость, и гнев, и крик, и злоречие со всякою злобою да будут удалены от вас;
texts.eph.4.32: но будьте друг ко другу добры, сострадательны, прощайте друг друга, как и Бог во Христе простил вас.
texts.eph.5.1: Итак, подражайте Богу, как чада возлюбленные,
texts.eph.5.2: и живите в любви, как и Христос возлюбил нас и предал Себя за нас в приношение и жертву Богу, в благоухание приятное.
texts.eph.5.3: А блуд и всякая нечистота и любостяжание не должны даже именоваться у вас, как прилично святым.
texts.eph.5.4: Также сквернословие и пустословие и смехотворство не приличны вам, а, напротив, благодарение;
texts.eph.5.5: ибо знайте, что никакой блудник, или нечистый, или любостяжатель, который есть идолослужитель, не имеет наследия в Царстве Христа и Бога.
texts.eph.5.6: Никто да не обольщает вас пустыми словами, ибо за это приходит гнев Божий на сынов противления;
texts.eph.5.8: Вы были некогда тьма, а теперь — свет в Господе: поступайте, как чада света,
texts.eph.5.9: потому что плод Духа состоит во всякой благости, праведности и истине.
texts.eph.5.11: и не участвуйте в бесплодных делах тьмы, но и обличайте.
texts.eph.5.12: Ибо о том, что они делают тайно, стыдно и говорить.
texts.eph.5.13: Все же обнаруживаемое делается явным от света, ибо все, делающееся явным, свет есть.
texts.eph.5.14: Посему сказано: "встань, спящий, и воскресни из мертвых, и осветит тебя Христос".
texts.eph.5.15: Итак, смотрите, поступайте осторожно, не как неразумные, но как мудрые,
texts.eph.5.16: дорожа временем, потому что дни лукавы.
texts.eph.5.17: Итак, не будьте нерассудительны, но познавайте, что есть воля Божия.
texts.eph.5.18: И не упивайтесь вином, от которого бывает распутство; но исполняйтесь Духом,
texts.eph.5.19: назидая самих себя псалмами и славословиями и песнопениями духовными, поя и воспевая в сердцах ваших Господу,
texts.eph.5.20: благодаря всегда за все Бога и Отца, во имя Господа нашего Иисуса Христа,
texts.eph.5.21: повинуясь друг другу в страхе Божием.
texts.eph.5.22: Жены, повинуйтесь своим мужьям, как Господу,
texts.eph.5.23: потому что муж есть глава жены, как и Христос глава Церкви, и Он же Спаситель тела.
texts.eph.5.24: Но как Церковь повинуется Христу, так и жены своим мужьям во всем.
texts.eph.5.25: Мужья, любите своих жен, как и Христос возлюбил Церковь и предал Себя за нее,
texts.eph.5.26: чтобы освятить ее, очистив банею водною посредством слова;
texts.eph.5.27: чтобы представить ее Себе славною Церковью, не имеющею пятна, или порока, или чего-либо подобного, но дабы она была свята и непорочна.
texts.eph.5.28: Так должны мужья любить своих жен, как свои тела: любящий свою жену любит самого себя.
texts.eph.5.29: Ибо никто никогда не имел ненависти к своей плоти, но питает и греет ее, как и Господь Церковь,
texts.eph.5.30: потому что мы члены Тела Его, от плоти Его и от костей Его.
texts.eph.5.31: Посему оставит человек отца своего и мать и прилепится к жене своей, и будут двое одна плоть.
texts.eph.5.32: Тайна сия велика; я говорю по отношению ко Христу и к Церкви.
texts.eph.5.33: Так каждый из вас да любит свою жену, как самого себя; а жена да боится своего мужа.
texts.eph.6.1: Дети, повинуйтесь своим родителям в Господе, ибо сего требует справедливость.
texts.eph.6.2: Почитай отца твоего и мать, это первая заповедь с обетованием:
texts.eph.6.3: да будет тебе благо, и будешь долголетен на земле.
texts.eph.6.4: И вы, отцы, не раздражайте детей ваших, но воспитывайте их в учении и наставлении Господнем.
texts.eph.6.5: Рабы, повинуйтесь господам своим по плоти со страхом и трепетом, в простоте сердца вашего, как Христу,
texts.eph.6.6: не с видимою только услужливостью, как человекоугодники, но как рабы Христовы, исполняя волю Божию от души,
texts.eph.6.7: служа с усердием, как Господу, а не как человекам,
texts.eph.6.8: зная, что каждый получит от Господа по мере добра, которое он сделал, раб ли, или свободный.
texts.eph.6.9: И вы, господа, поступайте с ними так же, умеряя строгость, зная, что и над вами самими и над ними есть на небесах Господь, у Которого нет лицеприятия.
texts.eph.6.10: Наконец, братия мои, укрепляйтесь Господом и могуществом силы Его.
texts.eph.6.11: Облекитесь во всеоружие Божие, чтобы вам можно было стать против козней диавольских,
texts.eph.6.12: потому что наша брань не против крови и плоти, но против начальств, против властей, против мироправителей тьмы века сего, против духов злобы поднебесной.
texts.eph.6.13: Для сего приимите всеоружие Божие, дабы вы могли противостать в день злый и, все преодолев, устоять.
texts.eph.6.14: Итак станьте, препоясав чресла ваши истиною и облекшись в броню праведности,
texts.eph.6.15: и обув ноги в готовность благовествовать мир;
texts.eph.6.16: а паче всего возьмите щит веры, которым возможете угасить все раскаленные стрелы лукавого;
texts.eph.6.17: и шлем спасения возьмите, и меч духовный, который есть Слово Божие.
texts.eph.6.18: Всякою молитвою и прошением молитесь во всякое время духом, и старайтесь о сем самом со всяким постоянством и молением о всех святых
texts.eph.6.19: и о мне, дабы мне дано было слово — устами моими открыто с дерзновением возвещать тайну благовествования,
texts.eph.6.20: для которого я исполняю посольство в узах, дабы я смело проповедывал, как мне должно.
texts.eph.6.21: А дабы и вы знали о моих обстоятельствах и делах, обо всем известит вас Тихик, возлюбленный брат и верный в Господе служитель,
texts.eph.6.22: которого я и послал к вам для того самого, чтобы вы узнали о нас и чтобы он утешил сердца ваши.
texts.eph.6.23: Мир братиям и любовь с верою от Бога Отца и Господа Иисуса Христа.
texts.eph.6.24: Благодать со всеми, неизменно любящими Господа нашего Иисуса Христа. Аминь.

texts.eph.1.1: Paulo, apostolo de Jesus Christo, pela vontade de Deus, aos sanctos que estão em Epheso, e fieis em Christo Jesus.
texts.eph.1.2: A vós graça, e paz da parte de Deus nosso Pae e do Senhor Jesus Christo.
texts.eph.1.3: Bemdito o Deus e Pae de nosso Senhor Jesus Christo, o qual nos abençoou com todas as bençãos espirituaes nos logares celestiaes em Christo.
texts.eph.1.4: Como nos elegeu n’elle antes da fundação do mundo, para que fossemos sanctos e irreprehensiveis diante d’elle em caridade;
texts.eph.1.5: E nos predestinou para filhos de adopção por Jesus Christo para si mesmo, segundo o beneplacito de sua vontade,
texts.eph.1.6: Para louvor da gloria da sua graça, pela qual nos fez agradaveis a si no Amado.
texts.eph.1.7: Em quem temos a redempção pelo seu sangue, a saber, a remissão das offensas, segundo as riquezas da sua graça.
texts.eph.1.8: Que elle fez abundar para comnosco em toda a sabedoria e prudencia;
texts.eph.1.9: Descobrindo-nos o mysterio da sua vontade, segundo o seu beneplacito, que propozera em si mesmo,
texts.eph.1.10: Para tornar a congregar em Christo todas as coisas, na dispensação da plenitude dos tempos, tanto as que estão nos céus como as que estão na terra,
texts.eph.1.11: N’elle, digo, em quem tambem fomos feitos herança, havendo sido predestinados, conforme o proposito d’aquelle que faz todas as coisas, segundo o conselho da sua vontade;
texts.eph.1.12: Para que fossemos para louvor da sua gloria, nós, os que primeiro esperámos em Christo,
texts.eph.1.13: Em quem tambem vós estaes, depois que ouvistes a palavra da verdade, a saber, o evangelho da vossa salvação, no qual tambem, havendo crido, fostes sellados com o Espirito Sancto da promessa.
texts.eph.1.14: O qual é o penhor da nossa herança, para redempção da possessão de Deus, para louvor da sua gloria.
texts.eph.1.15: Pelo que, ouvindo eu tambem a fé que entre vós ha no Senhor Jesus, e a caridade para com todos os sanctos,
texts.eph.1.16: Não cesso de dar graças a Deus por vós, lembrando-me de vós nas minhas orações;
texts.eph.1.17: Para que o Deus de nosso Senhor Jesus Christo, o Pae da gloria, vos dê em seu conhecimento o espirito de sabedoria e de revelação;
texts.eph.1.18: Illuminados os olhos de vosso entendimento, para que saibaes qual seja a esperança da sua vocação, e quaes as riquezas da gloria da sua herança nos sanctos;
texts.eph.1.19: E qual seja a sobre-excellente grandeza do seu poder em nós, os que crêmos, segundo a operação da força do seu poder,
texts.eph.1.20: A qual operou em Christo, resuscitando-o dos mortos, e o collocou á sua direita nos céus,
texts.eph.1.21: Sobre todo o principado, e poder, e potestade, e dominio e todo o nome que se nomeia, não só n’este seculo, mas tambem no vindouro;
texts.eph.1.22: E sujeitou todas as coisas a seus pés, e sobre todas as coisas o constituiu por cabeça da egreja,
texts.eph.1.23: A qual é o seu corpo, a plenitude d’aquelle que cumpre tudo em todos.
texts.eph.2.1: E vos vivificou, estando vós mortos pelas offensas e peccados,
texts.eph.2.2: Em que d’antes andastes segundo o curso d’este mundo, segundo o principe da potestade do ar, do espirito que agora opera nos filhos da desobediencia.
texts.eph.2.3: Entre os quaes todos nós tambem d’antes andavamos nos desejos da nossa carne, fazendo a vontade da carne e dos pensamentos; e eramos por natureza filhos da ira, como os outros tambem.
texts.eph.2.4: Porque Deus, que é riquissimo em misericordia, pelo seu muito amor com que nos amou,
texts.eph.2.5: Estando nós ainda mortos em nossas offensas, nos vivificou juntamente com Christo (pela graça sois salvos),
texts.eph.2.6: E nos resuscitou juntamente, e nos fez assentar juntamente nos céus, em Christo Jesus;
texts.eph.2.7: Para mostrar nos seculos vindouros as abundantes riquezas da sua graça, pela sua benignidade para comnosco em Christo Jesus.
texts.eph.2.8: Porque pela graça sois salvos, por meio da fé; e isto não vem de vós; é dom de Deus.
texts.eph.2.9: Não vem das obras, para que ninguem se glorie.
texts.eph.2.10: Porque somos feitura sua, creados em Christo Jesus para as boas obras, as quaes Deus preparou para que andassemos n’ellas.
texts.eph.2.11: Portanto, lembrae-vos de que vós d’antes ereis gentios na carne, e chamados incircumcisão pelos que na carne se chamam circumcisão feita pela mão dos homens;
texts.eph.2.12: Que n’aquelle tempo estaveis sem Christo, separados da communidade d’Israel, e estranhos aos concertos da promessa, não tendo esperança, e sem Deus no mundo.
texts.eph.2.13: Mas agora em Christo Jesus, vós, que d’antes estaveis longe, já pelo sangue de Christo chegastes perto.
texts.eph.2.14: Porque elle é a nossa paz, o qual de ambos os povos fez um; e, derribando a parede de separação que estava no meio,
texts.eph.2.15: Na sua carne desfez a inimizade, a saber, a lei dos mandamentos, que consistia em tradições, para crear em si mesmo os dois em um novo homem, fazendo a paz,
texts.eph.2.16: E pela cruz reconciliar com Deus a ambos em um corpo, matando n’ella as inimizades.
texts.eph.2.17: E, vindo, elle evangelizou a paz, a vós que estaveis longe, e aos que estavam perto;
texts.eph.2.18: Porque por elle ambos temos accesso em um mesmo Espirito ao Pae.
texts.eph.2.19: Assim que já não sois estrangeiros, nem forasteiros, mas concidadãos dos sanctos e domesticos de Deus;
texts.eph.2.20: Edificados sobre o fundamento dos apostolos e dos prophetas, de que Jesus Christo é a principal pedra da esquina;
texts.eph.2.21: No qual todo o edificio, bem ajustado, cresce para templo sancto no Senhor.
texts.eph.2.22: No qual tambem vós juntamente sois edificados para morada de Deus em Espirito.
texts.eph.3.1: Por esta causa eu, Paulo, sou o prisioneiro de Jesus Christo por vós, os gentios;
texts.eph.3.2: Se é que tendes ouvido a dispensação da graça de Deus, que para comvosco me foi dada;
texts.eph.3.3: Como me foi este mysterio manifestado pela revelação (como acima em poucas palavras vos escrevi;
texts.eph.3.4: Pelo que, lendo, podeis entender a minha sciencia n’este mysterio de Christo),
texts.eph.3.5: O qual n’outros seculos não foi manifestado aos filhos dos homens, como agora é revelado pelo Espirito aos seus sanctos apostolos e prophetas;
texts.eph.3.6: A saber, que os gentios são coherdeiros, e de um mesmo corpo, e participantes da sua promessa em Christo pelo evangelho;
texts.eph.3.7: Do qual sou feito ministro, pelo dom da graça de Deus, que me foi dado segundo a operação do seu poder.
texts.eph.3.8: A mim, o minimo de todos os sanctos, me foi dada esta graça de annunciar entre os gentios, por meio do evangelho, as riquezas incomprehensiveis de Christo,
texts.eph.3.9: E mostrar a todos qual seja a communhão do mysterio, que desde todos os seculos esteve occulto em Deus, que por Christo Jesus creou todas as coisas;
texts.eph.3.10: Para que agora pela egreja a multiforme sabedoria de Deus seja manifestada aos principados e potestades nos céus,
texts.eph.3.11: Segundo o eterno proposito que fez em Christo Jesus nosso Senhor:
texts.eph.3.12: No qual temos ousadia e accesso com confiança, pela fé n’elle.
texts.eph.3.13: Portanto vos peço que não desfalleçaes nas minhas tribulações por vós, que são a vossa gloria.
texts.eph.3.14: Por causa d’isto me ponho de joelhos perante o Pae de nosso Senhor Jesus Christo,
texts.eph.3.15: Do qual toda a familia nos céus e na terra toma o nome.
texts.eph.3.16: Para que, segundo as riquezas da sua gloria, vos conceda que sejaes corroborados com poder pelo seu Espirito no homem interior;
texts.eph.3.17: Para que Christo habite pela fé nos vossos corações; para que, estando arraigados e fundados em amor,
texts.eph.3.18: Possaes perfeitamente comprehender, com todos os sanctos, qual seja a largura, e o comprimento, e a altura, e a profundidade,
texts.eph.3.19: E conhecer o amor de Christo, que excede todo o entendimento, para que sejaes cheios de toda a plenitude de Deus.
texts.eph.3.20: Ora, áquelle que é poderoso para fazer tudo muito mais abundantemente do que pedimos ou pensamos, segundo o poder que em nós opéra,
texts.eph.3.21: A esse gloria na egreja, por Jesus Christo, em todas as geracões, para todo o sempre. Amen.
texts.eph.4.1: Rogo-vos, pois, eu, o preso do Senhor, que andeis como é digno da vocação com que sois chamados,
texts.eph.4.2: Com toda a humildade e mansidão, com longanimidade, supportando-vos uns aos outros em amor,
texts.eph.4.3: Procurando guardar a unidade de Espirito pelo vinculo da paz.
texts.eph.4.4: Ha um só corpo e um só Espirito, como tambem fostes chamados em uma só esperança da vossa vocação;
texts.eph.4.5: Um só Senhor, uma só fé, um só baptismo;
texts.eph.4.6: Um só Deus e Pae de todos, o qual é sobre todos, e por todos e em todos.
texts.eph.4.7: Porém a graça é dada a cada um de nós segundo a medida do dom de Christo.
texts.eph.4.8: Pelo que diz: Subindo ao alto, levou captivo o captiveiro, e deu dons aos homem.
texts.eph.4.9: Ora, isto, que subiu, que é, senão que tambem antes tinha descido ás partes mais baixas da terra?
texts.eph.4.10: Aquelle que desceu é tambem o mesmo que subiu acima de todos os céus, para cumprir todas as coisas.
texts.eph.4.11: E elle mesmo deu uns para apostolos, e outros para prophetas, e outros para evangelistas, e outros para pastores e doutores,
texts.eph.4.12: Para aperfeiçoamento dos sanctos, para obra do ministerio, para edificação do corpo de Christo;
texts.eph.4.13: Até que todos cheguemos á unidade da fé, e ao conhecimento do Filho de Deus, a varão perfeito, á medida da estatura completa de Christo.
texts.eph.4.14: Para que não sejamos mais meninos, inconstantes, levados em roda de todo o vento de doutrina, pelo engano dos homens que com astucia enganam fraudulosamente.
texts.eph.4.15: Antes, seguindo a verdade em caridade, cresçamos em tudo n’aquelle que é a cabeça, Christo.
texts.eph.4.16: Do qual todo o corpo, bem ajustado, e ligado pelo que todas as juntas lhe subministram, segundo a operação de cada parte na sua medida, tome augmento do corpo, para sua edificação em amor.
texts.eph.4.17: De sorte que digo isto, e testifico no Senhor, para que não andeis mais como andam tambem os outros gentios, na vaidade do seu sentido,
texts.eph.4.18: Entenebrecidos no entendimento, separados da vida de Deus pela ignorancia que ha n’elles, pela dureza do seu coração:
texts.eph.4.19: Os quaes, havendo perdido todo o sentimento, se entregaram á dissolução, para com avidez commetterem toda a impureza.
texts.eph.4.20: Mas vós não aprendestes assim a Christo,
texts.eph.4.21: Se é que o tendes ouvido, e n’elle fostes ensinados, como a verdade está, em Jesus;
texts.eph.4.22: Que, quanto ao trato passado vos despojeis do velho homem, que se corrompe pelas concupiscencias do engano;
texts.eph.4.23: E vos renoveis no espirito do vosso sentido;
texts.eph.4.24: E vos vistaes do novo homem, que segundo Deus é creado em verdadeira justiça e sanctidade.
texts.eph.4.25: Pelo que deixae a mentira, e fallae a verdade cada um com o seu proximo; porque somos membros uns dos outros.
texts.eph.4.26: Irae-vos, e não pequeis; não se ponha o sol sobre a vossa ira.
texts.eph.4.28: Aquelle que furtava, não furte mais; antes trabalhe, obrando com suas mãos o que é bom, para que tenha que repartir com o que tiver necessidade.
texts.eph.4.29: Não saia da vossa bocca nenhuma palavra torpe, mas só a que fôr boa para utilidade da edificação, para que dê graça aos que a ouvem.
texts.eph.4.30: E não entristeçaes o Espirito Sancto de Deus, no qual estaes sellados para o dia da redempção.
texts.eph.4.31: Toda a amargura, e ira, e colera, e gritaria, e blasphemias e toda a malicia seja tirada de entre vós.
texts.eph.4.32: Antes sêde uns para com os outros benignos, misericordiosos, perdoando-vos uns aos outros, como tambem Deus vos perdoou em Christo.
texts.eph.5.1: Sêde pois imitadores de Deus, como filhos amados;
texts.eph.5.2: E andae em amor, como tambem Christo nos amou, e se entregou a si mesmo por nós, em offerta e sacrificio a Deus, em cheiro suave.
texts.eph.5.3: Mas a fornicação, e toda a immundicia ou avareza, nem ainda se nomeie entre vós, como convém a sanctos;
texts.eph.5.4: Nem torpezas, nem parvoices, nem chocarrices, que não conveem; mas antes acções de graças.
texts.eph.5.5: Porque bem sabeis isto: que nenhum fornicario, ou immundo, ou avarento, que é idolatra, tem herança no reino de Christo e de Deus.
texts.eph.5.6: Ninguem vos engane com palavras vãs; porque por estas coisas vem a ira de Deus sobre os filhos da desobediencia.
texts.eph.5.8: Porque d’antes ereis trevas, mas agora sois luz no Senhor: andae como filhos da luz
texts.eph.5.9: (Porque o fructo do Espirito consiste em toda a bondade, e justiça e verdade);
texts.eph.5.10: Approvando o que é agradavel ao Senhor.
texts.eph.5.11: E não communiqueis com as obras infructuosas das trevas, mas antes condemnae-as.
texts.eph.5.12: Porque o que elles fazem em occulto até dizel-o é coisa torpe.
texts.eph.5.13: Mas todas estas coisas se manifestam sendo condemnadas pela luz, porque tudo o que se manifesta é luz.
texts.eph.5.14: Pelo que diz: Desperta, tu que dormes, e levanta-te d’entre os mortos, e Christo te esclarecerá.
texts.eph.5.15: Portanto, vêde como andaes prudentemente, não como nescios, mas como sabios,
texts.eph.5.16: Remindo o tempo; porquanto os dias são maus.
texts.eph.5.17: Pelo que não sejaes insensatos, mas entendei qual seja a vontade do Senhor.
texts.eph.5.18: E não vos embriagueis com vinho, em que ha dissolução, mas enchei-vos do Espirito;
texts.eph.5.19: Fallando entre vós em psalmos, e hymnos, e canticos espirituaes: cantando e psalmodiando ao Senhor no vosso coração:
texts.eph.5.20: Dando sempre graças por todas as coisas a nosso Deus e Pae, em nome de nosso Senhor Jesus Christo:
texts.eph.5.21: Sujeitando-vos uns aos outros no temor de Deus.
texts.eph.5.22: Vós, mulheres, sujeitae-vos a vossos proprios maridos, como ao Senhor;
texts.eph.5.23: Porque o marido é a cabeça da mulher, como tambem Christo a cabeça da egreja: e elle é o salvador do corpo.
texts.eph.5.24: De sorte que, assim como a egreja está sujeita a Christo, assim tambem as mulheres estejam em tudo sujeitas a seus proprios maridos.
texts.eph.5.25: Vós, maridos, amae as vossas proprias mulheres, como tambem Christo amou a egreja, e a si mesmo se entregou por ella,
texts.eph.5.26: Para a sanctificar, purificando-a com a lavagem da agua, pela palavra,
texts.eph.5.27: Para a apresentar a si mesmo egreja gloriosa, que não tivesse macula, nem ruga, nem coisa similhante, mas que fosse sancta e irreprehensivel.
texts.eph.5.28: Assim devem os maridos amar a suas proprias mulheres, como a seus proprios corpos. Quem ama a sua propria mulher, ama-se a si mesmo.
texts.eph.5.29: Porque nunca ninguem aborreceu a sua propria carne; antes a alimenta e sustenta, como tambem o Senhor á egreja;
texts.eph.5.30: Porque somos membros do seu corpo, da sua carne, e dos seus ossos.
texts.eph.5.31: Por isso deixará o homem seu pae e sua mãe, e se ajuntará com sua mulher; e serão dois n’uma carne.
texts.eph.5.32: Grande é este mysterio: digo, porém, isto de Christo e da egreja.
texts.eph.5.33: Assim tambem vós cada um em particular ame a sua propria mulher como a si mesmo, e a mulher reverenceie o marido.
texts.eph.6.1: Vós, filhos, sêde obedientes a vossos paes no Senhor, porque isto é justo.
texts.eph.6.2: Honra a teu pae e a tua mãe, que é o primeiro mandamento com promessa,
texts.eph.6.3: Para que te vá bem, e vivas muito tempo sobre a terra.
texts.eph.6.4: E vós, paes, não provoqueis a ira a vossos filhos, mas creae-os na doutrina e admoestação do Senhor.
texts.eph.6.5: Vós, servos, obedecei a vossos senhores segundo a carne, com temor e tremor, na sinceridade de vosso coração, como a Christo;
texts.eph.6.6: Não servindo á vista, como agradando a homens, mas como servos de Christo, fazendo de coração a vontade de Deus,
texts.eph.6.7: Servindo de boa vontade ao Senhor, e não aos homens.
texts.eph.6.8: Sabendo que cada um receberá do Senhor todo o bem que fizer, seja servo, seja livre.
texts.eph.6.9: E vós senhores, fazei o mesmo para com elles, deixando as ameaças, sabendo tambem que o Senhor d’elles e vosso está no céu, e que para com elle não ha accepção de pessoas.
texts.eph.6.10: No demais, irmãos meus, fortalecei-vos no Senhor e na força do seu poder.
texts.eph.6.11: Revesti-vos de toda a armadura de Deus, para que possaes estar firmes contra as astutas ciladas do diabo.
texts.eph.6.12: Porque não temos que luctar contra a carne e o sangue, mas sim contra os principados, contra as potestades, contra os principes das trevas d’este seculo, contra as malicias espirituaes em os ares.
texts.eph.6.13: Portanto tomae toda a armadura de Deus, para que possaes resistir no dia mau, e, havendo feito tudo, ficar firmes.
texts.eph.6.14: Estae pois firmes, tendo cingidos os vossos lombos com a verdade, e vestidos com a couraça da justiça;
texts.eph.6.15: E calçados os pés com a preparação do evangelho da paz:
texts.eph.6.16: Tomando sobretudo o escudo da fé, com o qual possaes apagar todos os dardos inflammados do maligno.
texts.eph.6.17: Tomae tambem o capacete da salvação, e a espada do Espirito, que é a palavra de Deus:
texts.eph.6.18: Orando em todo o tempo com toda a oração e supplica em espirito, e vigiando n’isto com toda a perseverança e supplica por todos os sanctos,
texts.eph.6.19: E por mim; para que me seja dada, no abrir da minha bocca, a palavra com confiança, para fazer notorio o mysterio do evangelho.
texts.eph.6.20: Pelo qual sou embaixador em cadeias; para que possa fallar d’elle livremente, como me convém fallar.
texts.eph.6.21: Ora, para que vós tambem possaes saber os meus negocios, e o que eu faço, Tychico, irmão amado, e fiel ministro do Senhor, vos informará de tudo.
texts.eph.6.22: O qual vos enviei para o mesmo fim, para que saibaes os nossos negocios, e elle console os vossos corações.
texts.eph.6.23: Paz seja com os irmãos, e caridade com fé da parte de Deus Pae e da do Senhor Jesus Christo.
texts.eph.6.24: A graça seja com todos os que amam a nosso Senhor Jesus Christo em sinceridade. Amen.

texts.eph.1.1: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the will of God, to the saints who are at Ephesus, and to the faithful in Christ Jesus:
texts.eph.1.2: Grace be to you, and peace from God our Father, and from the Lord Jesus Christ.
texts.eph.1.3: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who hath blessed us with all spiritual blessings in heavenly places in Christ:
texts.eph.1.4: According as he hath chosen us in him, before the foundation of the world, that we should be holy and without blame before him in love:
texts.eph.1.5: Having predestinated us to the adoption of children to himself by Jesus Christ, according to the good pleasure of his will,
texts.eph.1.6: To the praise of the glory of his grace, in which he hath made us accepted in the beloved:
texts.eph.1.7: In whom we have redemption through his blood, the forgiveness of sins, according to the riches of his grace;
texts.eph.1.8: In which he hath abounded towards us in all wisdom and prudence;
texts.eph.1.9: Having made known to us the mystery of his will, according to his good pleasure which he hath purposed in himself:
texts.eph.1.10: That in the dispensation of the fullness of times he might collect in one all things in Christ, both which are in heaven, and which are on earth; even in him:
texts.eph.1.11: In whom also we have obtained an inheritance, being predestinated according to the purpose of him who worketh all things after the counsel of his own will:
texts.eph.1.12: That we should be to the praise of his glory, who first trusted in Christ.
texts.eph.1.13: In whom ye also trusted, after ye heard the word of truth, the gospel of your salvation: in whom also after ye believed, ye were sealed with that holy Spirit of promise,
texts.eph.1.14: Which is the earnest of our inheritance until the redemption of the purchased possession, to the praise of his glory.
texts.eph.1.15: Wherefore I also, having heard of your faith in the Lord Jesus, and love to all the saints,
texts.eph.1.16: Cease not to give thanks for you, making mention of you in my prayers;
texts.eph.1.17: That the God of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of glory, may give to you the spirit of wisdom and revelation in the knowledge of him:
texts.eph.1.18: The eyes of your understanding being enlightened; that ye may know what is the hope of his calling, and what the riches of the glory of his inheritance in the saints,
texts.eph.1.19: And what is the exceeding greatness of his power toward us who believe, according to the working of his mighty power,
texts.eph.1.20: Which he wrought in Christ, when he raised him from the dead, and set him at his own right hand in the heavenly places,
texts.eph.1.21: Far above all principality, and power, and might, and dominion, and every name that is named, not only in this world, but also in that which is to come:
texts.eph.1.22: And put all things under his feet, and gave him to be the head over all things to the church,
texts.eph.1.23: Which is his body, the fullness of him that filleth all in all.
texts.eph.2.1: And you hath he revived, who were dead in trespasses and sins;
texts.eph.2.2: In which in time past ye walked according to the course of this world, according to the prince of the power of the air, the spirit that now worketh in the children of disobedience:
texts.eph.2.3: Among whom also we all had our manner of life in times past in the lusts of our flesh, fulfilling the desires of the flesh and of the mind; and were by nature the children of wrath, even as others.
texts.eph.2.4: But God, who is rich in mercy, for his great love with which he loved us,
texts.eph.2.5: Even when we were dead in sins, hath made us alive together with Christ, (by grace ye are saved;)
texts.eph.2.6: And hath raised us up together, and made us sit together in heavenly places, in Christ Jesus:
texts.eph.2.7: That in the ages to come he might show the exceeding riches of his grace in his kindness towards us, through Christ Jesus.
texts.eph.2.8: For by grace are ye saved, through faith; and that not of yourselves: it is the gift of God:
texts.eph.2.9: Not by works, lest any man should boast.
texts.eph.2.10: For we are his workmanship, created in Christ Jesus to good works, which God hath before ordained that we should walk in them.
texts.eph.2.11: Wherefore remember, that ye being in time past Gentiles in the flesh, who are called Uncircumcision by that which is called the Circumcision in the flesh made by hands;
texts.eph.2.12: That at that time ye were without Christ, being aliens from the commonwealth of Israel, and strangers from the covenants of promise, having no hope, and without God in the world:
texts.eph.2.13: But now, in Christ Jesus, ye, who formerly were far off, are made nigh by the blood of Christ.
texts.eph.2.14: For he is our peace, who hath made both one, and hath broken down the middle wall of partition between us;
texts.eph.2.15: Having abolished in his flesh the enmity, even the law of commandments contained in ordinances: to make in himself of two one new man, so making peace;
texts.eph.2.16: And that he might reconcile both to God in one body by the cross, having by it slain the enmity:
texts.eph.2.17: And came and preached peace to you who were afar off, and to them that were nigh.
texts.eph.2.18: For through him we both have an access by one Spirit to the Father.
texts.eph.2.19: Now therefore ye are no more strangers and foreigners, but fellow-citizens with the saints, and of the household of God;
texts.eph.2.20: And are built upon the foundation of the apostles and prophets, Jesus Christ himself being the chief corner-stone;
texts.eph.2.21: In whom all the building fitly framed together, groweth to a holy temple in the Lord:
texts.eph.2.22: In whom ye also are built together, for a habitation of God through the Spirit.
texts.eph.3.1: For this cause, I Paul, the prisoner of Jesus Christ for you Gentiles,
texts.eph.3.2: If ye have heard of the dispensation of the grace of God which is given me on your account.
texts.eph.3.3: That by revelation he made known to me the mystery, as I wrote before in few words;
texts.eph.3.4: By which when ye read, ye may understand my knowledge in the mystery of Christ,
texts.eph.3.5: Which in other ages was not made known to the sons of men, as it is now revealed to his holy apostles and prophets by the Spirit;
texts.eph.3.6: That the Gentiles should be joint-heirs, and of the same body, and partakers of his promise in Christ by the Gospel:
texts.eph.3.7: Of which I was made a minister, according to the gift of the grace of God given to me by the effectual working of his power.
texts.eph.3.8: To me, who am less than the least of all saints, is this grace given, that I should preach among the Gentiles the unsearchable riches of Christ;
texts.eph.3.9: And to make all men see what is the fellowship of the mystery, which from the beginning of the world hath been hid in God, who created all things by Jesus Christ:
texts.eph.3.10: To the intent that now to the principalities and powers in heavenly places might be known by the church the manifold wisdom of God,
texts.eph.3.11: According to the eternal purpose which he purposed in Christ Jesus our Lord:
texts.eph.3.12: In whom we have boldness and access with confidence by the faith of him,
texts.eph.3.13: Wherefore I desire that ye faint not at my tribulations for you, which is your glory.
texts.eph.3.14: For this cause I bow my knees to the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ,
texts.eph.3.15: Of whom the whole family in heaven and earth is named,
texts.eph.3.16: That he would grant you according to the riches of his glory to be strengthened with might by his Spirit in the inner man;
texts.eph.3.17: That Christ may dwell in your hearts by faith; that ye, being rooted and grounded in love,
texts.eph.3.18: May be able to comprehend with all saints what is the breadth, and length, and depth, and highth.
texts.eph.3.19: And to know the love of Christ, which passeth knowledge, that ye may be filled with all the fullness of God.
texts.eph.3.20: Now to him that is able to do exceeding abundantly above all that we ask or think, according to the power that worketh in us.
texts.eph.3.21: To him be glory in the church by Christ Jesus throughout all ages, world without end. Amen.
texts.eph.4.1: I therefore, the prisoner of the Lord, beseech you that ye walk worthy of the vocation by which ye are called,
texts.eph.4.2: With all lowliness and meekness, with long-suffering, forbearing one another in love;
texts.eph.4.3: Endeavoring to keep the unity of the Spirit in the bond of peace.
texts.eph.4.4: There is one body, and one Spirit, even as ye are called in one hope of your calling;
texts.eph.4.5: One Lord, one faith, one baptism,
texts.eph.4.6: One God and Father of all, who is above all, and through all, and in you all.
texts.eph.4.7: But to every one of us is given grace according to the measure of the gift of Christ.
texts.eph.4.8: Wherefore he saith, When he ascended on high, he led captivity captive, and gave gifts to men.
texts.eph.4.9: Now that he ascended, what is it but that he also descended first into the lower parts of the earth?
texts.eph.4.10: He that descended is the same also that ascended far above all heavens, that he might fill all things.
texts.eph.4.11: And he gave some, apostles; and some, prophets; and some, evangelists; and some, pastors and teachers;
texts.eph.4.12: For the perfecting of the saints, for the work of the ministry, for the edifying of the body of Christ:
texts.eph.4.13: Till we all come in the unity of the faith, and of the knowledge of the Son of God, to a perfect man, to the measure of the stature of the fullness of Christ:
texts.eph.4.14: That we henceforth be no more children, tossed to and fro, and carried about with every wind of doctrine, by the sleight of men, and cunning craftiness, by which they lie in wait to deceive:
texts.eph.4.15: But speaking the truth in love, may grow up into him in all things, who is the head, even Christ:
texts.eph.4.16: From whom the whole body fitly joined together and compacted by that which every joint supplieth, according to the effectual working in the measure of every part, maketh increase of the body to the edifying of itself in love.
texts.eph.4.17: This I say therefore, and testify in the Lord, that ye henceforth walk not as other Gentiles walk, in the vanity of their mind,
texts.eph.4.18: Having the understanding darkened, being alienated from the life of God through the ignorance that is in them, because of the blindness of their heart:
texts.eph.4.19: Who being past feeling have given themselves over to lasciviousness, to work all uncleanness with greediness.
texts.eph.4.20: But ye have not so learned Christ;
texts.eph.4.21: If indeed ye have heard him, and have been taught by him, as the truth is in Jesus:
texts.eph.4.22: That ye put off concerning the former manner of life the old man, which is corrupt according to the deceitful lusts:
texts.eph.4.23: And be renewed in the Spirit of your mind;
texts.eph.4.24: And that ye put on the new man, which after God is created in righteousness and true holiness.
texts.eph.4.25: Wherefore putting away lying, speak every man truth with his neighbor: for we are members one of another.
texts.eph.4.26: Be ye angry, and sin not: let not the sun go down upon your wrath:
texts.eph.4.27: Neither give place to the devil.
texts.eph.4.28: Let him that stole steal no more: but rather let him labor, working with his hands the thing which is good, that he may have to give to him that needeth.
texts.eph.4.29: Let no corrupt communication proceed out of your mouth, but that which is good to the use of edifying, that it may minister grace to the hearers.
texts.eph.4.30: And grieve not the holy Spirit of God, whereby ye are sealed to the day of redemption.
texts.eph.4.31: Let all bitterness, and wrath, and anger, and clamor, and evil-speaking, be put away from you, with all malice:
texts.eph.4.32: And be ye kind one to another, tender-hearted, forgiving one another, even as God for Christ's sake hath forgiven you.
texts.eph.5.1: Be ye therefore followers of God, as dear children;
texts.eph.5.2: And walk in love, as Christ also hath loved us, and hath given himself for us an offering and a sacrifice to God for a sweet-smelling savor.
texts.eph.5.3: But lewdness and all uncleanness or covetousness, let it not be once named among you, as becometh saints;
texts.eph.5.4: Neither filthiness, nor foolish talking, nor jesting, which are not convenient: but rather giving of thanks.
texts.eph.5.5: For this ye know, that no lewd, nor unclean person, nor covetous man, who is an idolater, hath any inheritance in the kingdom of Christ and of God.
texts.eph.5.6: Let no man deceive you with vain words: for because of these things cometh the wrath of God upon the children of disobedience.
texts.eph.5.7: Be ye not therefore partakers with them.
texts.eph.5.8: For ye were sometime darkness, but now are ye light in the Lord: walk as children of light;
texts.eph.5.9: (For the fruit of the Spirit is in all goodness, and righteousness, and truth;)
texts.eph.5.10: Proving what is acceptable to the Lord.
texts.eph.5.11: And have no fellowship with the unfruitful works of darkness, but rather reprove them.
texts.eph.5.12: For it is a shame even to speak of those things which are done by them in secret.
texts.eph.5.13: But all things that are reproved, are made manifest by the light: for whatever doth make manifest is light.
texts.eph.5.14: Wherefore he saith, Awake, thou that sleepest, and arise from the dead, and Christ will give thee light.
texts.eph.5.15: See then that ye walk circumspectly, not as fools, but as wise,
texts.eph.5.16: Redeeming the time, because the days are evil.
texts.eph.5.17: Wherefore be ye not unwise, but understanding what the will of the Lord is.
texts.eph.5.18: And be not drunk with wine, in which is excess; but be filled with the Spirit;
texts.eph.5.19: Speaking to yourselves in psalms, and hymns, and spiritual songs, singing and making melody in your heart to the Lord,
texts.eph.5.20: Giving thanks always for all things to God and the Father, in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ;
texts.eph.5.21: Submitting yourselves one to another in the fear of God.
texts.eph.5.22: Wives, submit yourselves to your own husbands, as to the Lord.
texts.eph.5.23: For the husband is the head of the wife, even as Christ is the head of the church: and he is the Savior of the body.
texts.eph.5.24: Therefore as the church is subject to Christ, so let wives be to their own husbands in every thing.
texts.eph.5.25: Husbands, love your wives, even as Christ also loved the church, and gave himself for it;
texts.eph.5.26: That he might sanctify and cleanse it with the washing of water by the word,
texts.eph.5.27: That he might present it to himself a glorious church, not having spot or wrinkle, or any such thing; but that it should be holy and without blemish.
texts.eph.5.28: So ought men to love their wives, as their own bodies. He that loveth his wife, loveth himself.
texts.eph.5.29: For no man ever yet hated his own flesh; but nourisheth and cherisheth it, even as the Lord the church:
texts.eph.5.30: For we are members of his body, of his flesh, and of his bones.
texts.eph.5.31: For this cause shall a man leave his father and mother, and shall be joined to his wife, and they two shall be one flesh.
texts.eph.5.32: This is a great mystery: but I speak concerning Christ and the church.
texts.eph.5.33: Nevertheless, let every one of you in particular so love his wife even as himself: and the wife see that she reverence her husband.
texts.eph.6.1: Children, obey your parents in the Lord: for this is right.
texts.eph.6.2: Honor thy father and mother (which is the first commandment with promise)
texts.eph.6.3: That it may be well with thee, and thou mayest live long on the earth.
texts.eph.6.4: And, ye fathers, provoke not your children to wrath: but bring them up in the nurture and admonition of the Lord.
texts.eph.6.5: Servants, be obedient to them that are your masters according to the flesh, with fear and trembling, in singleness of your heart, as to Christ;
texts.eph.6.6: Not with eye-service, as men-pleasers; but as the servants of Christ, doing the will of God from the heart;
texts.eph.6.7: With good will doing service, as to the Lord, and not to men:
texts.eph.6.8: Knowing that whatever good thing any man doeth, the same will he receive from the Lord, whether he be bond or free.
texts.eph.6.9: And, ye masters, do the same things to them, forbearing threatening: knowing that your Master also is in heaven; neither is there respect of persons with him.
texts.eph.6.10: Finally, my brethren, be strong in the Lord, and in the power of his might.
texts.eph.6.11: Put on the whole armor of God, that ye may be able to stand against the wiles of the devil.
texts.eph.6.12: For we wrestle not against flesh and blood, but against principalities, against powers, against the rulers of the darkness of this world, against spiritual wickedness in high places.
texts.eph.6.13: Wherefore take to you the whole armor of God, that ye may be able to withstand in the evil day, and having done all, to stand.
texts.eph.6.14: Stand therefore, having your loins girt about with truth, and having on the breast-plate of righteousness;
texts.eph.6.15: And your feet shod with the preparation of the gospel of peace;
texts.eph.6.16: Above all, taking the shield of faith, with which ye will be able to extinguish all the fiery darts of the wicked.
texts.eph.6.17: And take the helmet of salvation, and the sword of the Spirit, which is the word of God:
texts.eph.6.18: Praying always with all prayer and supplication in the Spirit, and watching for this purpose with all perseverance and supplication for all saints;
texts.eph.6.19: And for me, that utterance may be given to me, that I may open my mouth boldly, to make known the mystery of the gospel,
texts.eph.6.20: For which I am an embassador in bonds: that therein I may speak boldly, as I ought to speak.
texts.eph.6.21: But that ye also may know my affairs, and how I do, Tychicus, a beloved brother and faithful minister in the Lord, will make known to you all things:
texts.eph.6.22: Whom I have sent to you for the same purpose, that ye may know our affairs, and that he may comfort your hearts.
texts.eph.6.23: Peace be to the brethren, and love with faith from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
texts.eph.6.24: Grace be with all them that love our Lord Jesus Christ in sincerity. Amen.

texts.eph.1.1: Paul, apostle of Jesus Christ by God's will, to the saints and faithful in Christ Jesus who are at Ephesus.
texts.eph.1.2: Grace to you and peace from God our Father, and [the] Lord Jesus Christ.
texts.eph.1.3: Blessed [be] the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who has blessed us with every spiritual blessing in the heavenlies in Christ;
texts.eph.1.4: according as he has chosen us in him before [the] world's foundation, that we should be holy and blameless before him in love;
texts.eph.1.5: having marked us out beforehand for adoption through Jesus Christ to himself, according to the good pleasure of his will,
texts.eph.1.6: to [the] praise of [the] glory of his grace, wherein he has taken us into favour in the Beloved:
texts.eph.1.7: in whom we have redemption through his blood, the forgiveness of offences, according to the riches of his grace;
texts.eph.1.8: which he has caused to abound towards us in all wisdom and intelligence,
texts.eph.1.9: having made known to us the mystery of his will, according to his good pleasure which he purposed in himself
texts.eph.1.10: for [the] administration of the fulness of times; to head up all things in the Christ, the things in the heavens and the things upon the earth; in him,
texts.eph.1.11: in whom we have also obtained an inheritance, being marked out beforehand according to the purpose of him who works all things according to the counsel of his own will,
texts.eph.1.12: that we should be to [the] praise of his glory who have pre-trusted in the Christ:
texts.eph.1.13: in whom *ye* also [have trusted], having heard the word of the truth, the glad tidings of your salvation; in whom also, having believed, ye have been sealed with the Holy Spirit of promise,
texts.eph.1.14: who is [the] earnest of our inheritance to the redemption of the acquired possession to [the] praise of his glory.
texts.eph.1.15: Wherefore *I* also, having heard of the faith in the Lord Jesus which [is] in you, and the love which [ye have] towards all the saints,
texts.eph.1.16: do not cease giving thanks for you, making mention [of you] at my prayers,
texts.eph.1.17: that the God of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of glory, would give you [the] spirit of wisdom and revelation in the full knowledge of him,
texts.eph.1.18: being enlightened in the eyes of your heart, so that ye should know what is the hope of his calling, [and] what the riches of the glory of his inheritance in the saints,
texts.eph.1.19: and what the surpassing greatness of his power towards us who believe, according to the working of the might of his strength,
texts.eph.1.20: [in] which he wrought in the Christ [in] raising him from among [the] dead, and he set him down at his right hand in the heavenlies,
texts.eph.1.21: above every principality, and authority, and power, and dominion, and every name named, not only in this age, but also in that to come;
texts.eph.1.22: and has put all things under his feet, and gave him [to be] head over all things to the assembly,
texts.eph.1.23: which is his body, the fulness of him who fills all in all:
texts.eph.2.1: and *you*, being dead in your offences and sins --
texts.eph.2.2: in which ye once walked according to the age of this world, according to the ruler of the authority of the air, the spirit who now works in the sons of disobedience:
texts.eph.2.3: among whom *we* also all once had our conversation in the lusts of our flesh, doing what the flesh and the thoughts willed to do, and were children, by nature, of wrath, even as the rest:
texts.eph.2.4: but God, being rich in mercy, because of his great love wherewith he loved us,
texts.eph.2.5: (we too being dead in offences,) has quickened us with the Christ, (ye are saved by grace,)
texts.eph.2.6: and has raised [us] up together, and has made [us] sit down together in the heavenlies in Christ Jesus,
texts.eph.2.7: that he might display in the coming ages the surpassing riches of his grace in kindness towards us in Christ Jesus.
texts.eph.2.8: For ye are saved by grace, through faith; and this not of yourselves; it is God's gift:
texts.eph.2.9: not on the principle of works, that no one might boast.
texts.eph.2.10: For we are his workmanship, having been created in Christ Jesus for good works, which God has before prepared that we should walk in them.
texts.eph.2.11: Wherefore remember that *ye*, once nations in [the] flesh, who [are] called uncircumcision by that called circumcision in [the] flesh done with the hand;
texts.eph.2.12: that ye were at that time without Christ, aliens from the commonwealth of Israel, and strangers to the covenants of promise, having no hope, and without God in the world:
texts.eph.2.13: but now in Christ Jesus *ye* who once were afar off are become nigh by the blood of the Christ.
texts.eph.2.14: For *he* is our peace, who has made both one, and has broken down the middle wall of enclosure,
texts.eph.2.15: having annulled the enmity in his flesh, the law of commandments in ordinances, that he might form the two in himself into one new man, making peace;
texts.eph.2.16: and might reconcile both in one body to God by the cross, having by it slain the enmity;
texts.eph.2.17: and, coming, he has preached the glad tidings of peace to you who [were] afar off, and [the glad tidings of] peace to those [who were] nigh.
texts.eph.2.18: For through him we have both access by one Spirit to the Father.
texts.eph.2.19: So then ye are no longer strangers and foreigners, but ye are fellow-citizens of the saints, and of the household of God,
texts.eph.2.20: being built upon the foundation of the apostles and prophets, Jesus Christ himself being the corner-stone,
texts.eph.2.21: in whom all [the] building fitted together increases to a holy temple in the Lord;
texts.eph.2.22: in whom *ye* also are built together for a habitation of God in [the] Spirit.
texts.eph.3.1: For this reason *I* Paul, prisoner of the Christ Jesus for you nations,
texts.eph.3.2: (if indeed ye have heard of the administration of the grace of God which has been given to me towards you,
texts.eph.3.3: that by revelation the mystery has been made known to me, (according as I have written before briefly,
texts.eph.3.4: by which, in reading it, ye can understand my intelligence in the mystery of the Christ,)
texts.eph.3.5: which in other generations has not been made known to the sons of men, as it has now been revealed to his holy apostles and prophets in [the power of the] Spirit,
texts.eph.3.6: that [they who are of] the nations should be joint heirs, and a joint body, and joint partakers of [his] promise in Christ Jesus by the glad tidings;
texts.eph.3.7: of which I am become minister according to the gift of the grace of God given to me, according to the working of his power.
texts.eph.3.8: To me, less than the least of all saints, has this grace been given, to announce among the nations the glad tidings of the unsearchable riches of the Christ,
texts.eph.3.9: and to enlighten all [with the knowledge of] what is the administration of the mystery hidden throughout the ages in God, who has created all things,
texts.eph.3.10: in order that now to the principalities and authorities in the heavenlies might be made known through the assembly the all-various wisdom of God,
texts.eph.3.11: according to [the] purpose of the ages, which he purposed in Christ Jesus our Lord,
texts.eph.3.12: in whom we have boldness and access in confidence by the faith of him.
texts.eph.3.13: Wherefore I beseech [you] not to faint through my tribulations for you, which is your glory.
texts.eph.3.14: For this reason I bow my knees to the Father [of our Lord Jesus Christ],
texts.eph.3.15: of whom every family in [the] heavens and on earth is named,
texts.eph.3.16: in order that he may give you according to the riches of his glory, to be strengthened with power by his Spirit in the inner man;
texts.eph.3.17: that the Christ may dwell, through faith, in your hearts, being rooted and founded in love,
texts.eph.3.18: in order that ye may be fully able to apprehend with all the saints what [is] the breadth and length and depth and height;
texts.eph.3.19: and to know the love of the Christ which surpasses knowledge; that ye may be filled [even] to all the fulness of God.
texts.eph.3.20: But to him that is able to do far exceedingly above all which we ask or think, according to the power which works in us,
texts.eph.3.21: to him be glory in the assembly in Christ Jesus unto all generations of the age of ages. Amen).
texts.eph.4.1: *I*, the prisoner in [the] Lord, exhort you therefore to walk worthy of the calling wherewith ye have been called,
texts.eph.4.2: with all lowliness and meekness, with long-suffering, bearing with one another in love;
texts.eph.4.3: using diligence to keep the unity of the Spirit in the uniting bond of peace.
texts.eph.4.4: [There is] one body and one Spirit, as ye have been also called in one hope of your calling;
texts.eph.4.5: one Lord, one faith, one baptism;
texts.eph.4.6: one God and Father of all, who is over all, and through all, and in us all.
texts.eph.4.7: But to each one of us has been given grace according to the measure of the gift of the Christ.
texts.eph.4.8: Wherefore he says, Having ascended up on high, he has led captivity captive, and has given gifts to men.
texts.eph.4.9: But that he ascended, what is it but that he also descended into the lower parts of the earth?
texts.eph.4.10: He that descended is the same who has also ascended up above all the heavens, that he might fill all things;
texts.eph.4.11: and *he* has given some apostles, and some prophets, and some evangelists, and some shepherds and teachers,
texts.eph.4.12: for the perfecting of the saints; with a view to [the] work of [the] ministry, with a view to the edifying of the body of Christ;
texts.eph.4.13: until we all arrive at the unity of the faith and of the knowledge of the Son of God, at [the] full-grown man, at [the] measure of the stature of the fulness of the Christ;
texts.eph.4.14: in order that we may be no longer babes, tossed and carried about by every wind of *that* teaching [which is] in the sleight of men, in unprincipled cunning with a view to systematized error;
texts.eph.4.15: but, holding the truth in love, we may grow up to him in all things, who is the head, the Christ:
texts.eph.4.16: from whom the whole body, fitted together, and connected by every joint of supply, according to [the] working in [its] measure of each one part, works for itself the increase of the body to its self-building up in love.
texts.eph.4.17: This I say therefore, and testify in [the] Lord, that ye should no longer walk as [the rest of] the nations walk in [the] vanity of their mind,
texts.eph.4.18: being darkened in understanding, estranged from the life of God by reason of the ignorance which is in them, by reason of the hardness of their hearts,
texts.eph.4.19: who having cast off all feeling, have given themselves up to lasciviousness, to work all uncleanness with greedy unsatisfied lust.
texts.eph.4.20: But *ye* have not thus learnt the Christ,
texts.eph.4.21: if ye have heard him and been instructed in him according as [the] truth is in Jesus;
texts.eph.4.22: [namely] your having put off according to the former conversation the old man which corrupts itself according to the deceitful lusts;
texts.eph.4.23: and being renewed in the spirit of your mind;
texts.eph.4.24: and [your] having put on the new man, which according to God is created in truthful righteousness and holiness.
texts.eph.4.25: Wherefore, having put off falsehood, speak truth every one with his neighbour, because we are members one of another.
texts.eph.4.26: Be angry, and do not sin; let not the sun set upon your wrath,
texts.eph.4.27: neither give room for the devil.
texts.eph.4.28: Let the stealer steal no more, but rather let him toil, working what is honest with [his] hands, that he may have to distribute to him that has need.
texts.eph.4.29: Let no corrupt word go out of your mouth, but if [there be] any good one for needful edification, that it may give grace to those that hear [it].
texts.eph.4.30: And do not grieve the Holy Spirit of God, with which ye have been sealed for [the] day of redemption.
texts.eph.4.31: Let all bitterness, and heat of passion, and wrath, and clamour, and injurious language, be removed from you, with all malice;
texts.eph.4.32: and be to one another kind, compassionate, forgiving one another, so as God also in Christ has forgiven you.
texts.eph.5.1: Be ye therefore imitators of God, as beloved children,
texts.eph.5.2: and walk in love, even as the Christ loved us, and delivered himself up for us, an offering and sacrifice to God for a sweet-smelling savour.
texts.eph.5.3: But fornication and all uncleanness or unbridled lust, let it not be even named among you, as it becomes saints;
texts.eph.5.4: and filthiness and foolish talking, or jesting, which are not convenient; but rather thanksgiving.
texts.eph.5.5: For this ye are [well] informed of, knowing that no fornicator, or unclean person, or person of unbridled lust, who is an idolater, has inheritance in the kingdom of the Christ and God.
texts.eph.5.6: Let no one deceive you with vain words, for on account of these things the wrath of God comes upon the sons of disobedience.
texts.eph.5.7: Be not ye therefore fellow-partakers with them;
texts.eph.5.8: for ye were once darkness, but now light in [the] Lord; walk as children of light,
texts.eph.5.9: (for the fruit of the light [is] in all goodness and righteousness and truth,)
texts.eph.5.10: proving what is agreeable to the Lord;
texts.eph.5.11: and do not have fellowship with the unfruitful works of darkness, but rather also reprove [them],
texts.eph.5.12: for the things that are done by them in secret it is shameful even to say.
texts.eph.5.13: But all things having their true character exposed by the light are made manifest; for that which makes everything manifest is light.
texts.eph.5.14: Wherefore he says, Wake up, [thou] that sleepest, and arise up from among the dead, and the Christ shall shine upon thee.
texts.eph.5.15: See therefore how ye walk carefully, not as unwise but as wise,
texts.eph.5.16: redeeming the time, because the days are evil.
texts.eph.5.17: For this reason be not foolish, but understanding what [is] the will of the Lord.
texts.eph.5.18: And be not drunk with wine, in which is debauchery; but be filled with the Spirit,
texts.eph.5.19: speaking to yourselves in psalms and hymns and spiritual songs, singing and chanting with your heart to the Lord;
texts.eph.5.20: giving thanks at all times for all things to him [who is] God and [the] Father in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ,
texts.eph.5.21: submitting yourselves to one another in [the] fear of Christ.
texts.eph.5.22: Wives, [submit yourselves] to your own husbands, as to the Lord,
texts.eph.5.23: for a husband is head of the wife, as also the Christ [is] head of the assembly. *He* [is] Saviour of the body.
texts.eph.5.24: But even as the assembly is subjected to the Christ, so also wives to their own husbands in everything.
texts.eph.5.25: Husbands, love your own wives, even as the Christ also loved the assembly, and has delivered himself up for it,
texts.eph.5.26: in order that he might sanctify it, purifying [it] by the washing of water by [the] word,
texts.eph.5.27: that *he* might present the assembly to himself glorious, having no spot, or wrinkle, or any of such things; but that it might be holy and blameless.
texts.eph.5.28: So ought men also to love their own wives as their own bodies: he that loves his own wife loves himself.
texts.eph.5.29: For no one has ever hated his own flesh, but nourishes and cherishes it, even as also the Christ the assembly:
texts.eph.5.30: for we are members of his body; [we are of his flesh, and of his bones.]
texts.eph.5.31: Because of this a man shall leave his father and mother, and shall be united to his wife, and the two shall be one flesh.
texts.eph.5.32: This mystery is great, but *I* speak as to Christ, and as to the assembly.
texts.eph.5.33: But *ye* also, every one of you, let each so love his own wife as himself; but as to the wife [I speak] that she may fear the husband.
texts.eph.6.1: Children, obey your parents in [the] Lord, for this is just.
texts.eph.6.2: Honour thy father and thy mother, which is the first commandment with a promise,
texts.eph.6.3: that it may be well with thee, and that thou mayest be long-lived on the earth.
texts.eph.6.4: And [ye] fathers, do not provoke your children to anger, but bring them up in [the] discipline and admonition of [the] Lord.
texts.eph.6.5: Bondmen, obey masters according to flesh, with fear and trembling, in simplicity of your heart as to the Christ;
texts.eph.6.6: not with eye-service as men-pleasers; but as bondmen of Christ, doing the will of God from [the] soul,
texts.eph.6.7: serving with good will as to the Lord, and not to men;
texts.eph.6.8: knowing that whatever good each shall do, this he shall receive of [the] Lord, whether bond or free.
texts.eph.6.9: And, masters, do the same things towards them, giving up threatening, knowing that both their and your Master is in heaven, and there is no acceptance of persons with him.
texts.eph.6.10: For the rest, brethren, be strong in [the] Lord, and in the might of his strength.
texts.eph.6.11: Put on the panoply of God, that ye may be able to stand against the artifices of the devil:
texts.eph.6.12: because our struggle is not against blood and flesh, but against principalities, against authorities, against the universal lords of this darkness, against spiritual [power] of wickedness in the heavenlies.
texts.eph.6.13: For this reason take [to you] the panoply of God, that ye may be able to withstand in the evil day, and, having accomplished all things, to stand.
texts.eph.6.14: Stand therefore, having girt about your loins with truth, and having put on the breastplate of righteousness,
texts.eph.6.15: and shod your feet with [the] preparation of the glad tidings of peace:
texts.eph.6.16: besides all [these], having taken the shield of faith with which ye will be able to quench all the inflamed darts of the wicked one.
texts.eph.6.17: Have also the helmet of salvation, and the sword of the Spirit, which is God's word;
texts.eph.6.18: praying at all seasons, with all prayer and supplication in [the] Spirit, and watching unto this very thing with all perseverance and supplication for all the saints;
texts.eph.6.19: and for me in order that utterance may be given to me in [the] opening of my mouth to make known with boldness the mystery of the glad tidings,
texts.eph.6.20: for which I am an ambassador [bound] with a chain, that I may be bold in it as I ought to speak.
texts.eph.6.21: But in order that *ye* also may know what concerns me, how I am getting on, Tychicus, the beloved brother and faithful minister in [the] Lord, shall make all things known to you;
texts.eph.6.22: whom I have sent to you for this very thing, that ye may know of our affairs and that he may encourage your hearts.
texts.eph.6.23: Peace to the brethren, and love with faith, from God [the] Father and [the] Lord Jesus Christ.
texts.eph.6.24: Grace with all them that love our Lord Jesus Christ in incorruption.

texts.eph.1.1: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ through the will of God, to the saints who are in Ephesus, and to the faithful in Christ Jesus:
texts.eph.1.2: Grace to you, and peace from God our Father, and the Lord Jesus Christ!
texts.eph.1.3: Blessed [is] the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who did bless us in every spiritual blessing in the heavenly places in Christ,
texts.eph.1.4: according as He did choose us in him before the foundation of the world, for our being holy and unblemished before Him, in love,
texts.eph.1.5: having foreordained us to the adoption of sons through Jesus Christ to Himself, according to the good pleasure of His will,
texts.eph.1.6: to the praise of the glory of His grace, in which He did make us accepted in the beloved,
texts.eph.1.7: in whom we have the redemption through his blood, the remission of the trespasses, according to the riches of His grace,
texts.eph.1.8: in which He did abound toward us in all wisdom and prudence,
texts.eph.1.9: having made known to us the secret of His will, according to His good pleasure, that He purposed in Himself,
texts.eph.1.10: in regard to the dispensation of the fulness of the times, to bring into one the whole in the Christ, both the things in the heavens, and the things upon the earth -- in him;
texts.eph.1.11: in whom also we did obtain an inheritance, being foreordained according to the purpose of Him who the all things is working according to the counsel of His will,
texts.eph.1.12: for our being to the praise of His glory, [even] those who did first hope in the Christ,
texts.eph.1.13: in whom ye also, having heard the word of the truth -- the good news of your salvation -- in whom also having believed, ye were sealed with the Holy Spirit of the promise,
texts.eph.1.14: which is an earnest of our inheritance, to the redemption of the acquired possession, to the praise of His glory.
texts.eph.1.15: Because of this I also, having heard of your faith in the Lord Jesus, and the love to all the saints,
texts.eph.1.16: do not cease giving thanks for you, making mention of you in my prayers,
texts.eph.1.17: that the God of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of the glory, may give to you a spirit of wisdom and revelation in the recognition of him,
texts.eph.1.18: the eyes of your understanding being enlightened, for your knowing what is the hope of His calling, and what the riches of the glory of His inheritance in the saints,
texts.eph.1.19: and what the exceeding greatness of His power to us who are believing, according to the working of the power of His might,
texts.eph.1.20: which He wrought in the Christ, having raised him out of the dead, and did set [him] at His right hand in the heavenly [places],
texts.eph.1.21: far above all principality, and authority, and might, and lordship, and every name named, not only in this age, but also in the coming one;
texts.eph.1.22: and all things He did put under his feet, and did give him -- head over all things to the assembly,
texts.eph.1.23: which is his body, the fulness of Him who is filling the all in all,
texts.eph.2.1: Also you -- being dead in the trespasses and the sins,
texts.eph.2.2: in which once ye did walk according to the age of this world, according to the ruler of the authority of the air, of the spirit that is now working in the sons of disobedience,
texts.eph.2.3: among whom also we all did walk once in the desires of our flesh, doing the wishes of the flesh and of the thoughts, and were by nature children of wrath -- as also the others,
texts.eph.2.4: and God, being rich in kindness, because of His great love with which He loved us,
texts.eph.2.5: even being dead in the trespasses, did make us to live together with the Christ, (by grace ye are having been saved,)
texts.eph.2.6: and did raise [us] up together, and did seat [us] together in the heavenly [places] in Christ Jesus,
texts.eph.2.7: that He might show, in the ages that are coming, the exceeding riches of His grace in kindness toward us in Christ Jesus,
texts.eph.2.8: for by grace ye are having been saved, through faith, and this not of you -- of God the gift,
texts.eph.2.9: not of works, that no one may boast;
texts.eph.2.10: for of Him we are workmanship, created in Christ Jesus to good works, which God did before prepare, that in them we may walk.
texts.eph.2.11: Wherefore, remember, that ye [were] once the nations in the flesh, who are called Uncircumcision by that called Circumcision in the flesh made by hands,
texts.eph.2.12: that ye were at that time apart from Christ, having been alienated from the commonwealth of Israel, and strangers to the covenants of the promise, having no hope, and without God, in the world;
texts.eph.2.13: and now, in Christ Jesus, ye being once afar off became nigh in the blood of the Christ,
texts.eph.2.14: for he is our peace, who did make both one, and the middle wall of the enclosure did break down,
texts.eph.2.15: the enmity in his flesh, the law of the commands in ordinances having done away, that the two he might create in himself into one new man, making peace,
texts.eph.2.16: and might reconcile both in one body to God through the cross, having slain the enmity in it,
texts.eph.2.17: and having come, he did proclaim good news -- peace to you -- the far-off and the nigh,
texts.eph.2.18: because through him we have the access -- we both -- in one Spirit unto the Father.
texts.eph.2.19: Then, therefore, ye are no more strangers and foreigners, but fellow-citizens of the saints, and of the household of God,
texts.eph.2.20: being built upon the foundation of the apostles and prophets, Jesus Christ himself being chief corner-[stone],
texts.eph.2.21: in whom all the building fitly framed together doth increase to an holy sanctuary in the Lord,
texts.eph.2.22: in whom also ye are builded together, for a habitation of God in the Spirit.
texts.eph.3.1: For this cause, I Paul, the prisoner of Christ Jesus for you the nations,
texts.eph.3.2: if, indeed, ye did hear of the dispensation of the grace of God that was given to me in regard to you,
texts.eph.3.3: that by revelation He made known to me the secret, according as I wrote before in few [words] --
texts.eph.3.4: in regard to which ye are able, reading [it], to understand my knowledge in the secret of the Christ,
texts.eph.3.5: which in other generations was not made known to the sons of men, as it was now revealed to His holy apostles and prophets in the Spirit --
texts.eph.3.6: that the nations be fellow-heirs, and of the same body, and partakers of His promise in the Christ, through the good news,
texts.eph.3.7: of which I became a ministrant, according to the gift of the grace of God that was given to me, according to the working of His power;
texts.eph.3.8: to me -- the less than the least of all the saints -- was given this grace, among the nations to proclaim good news -- the untraceable riches of the Christ,
texts.eph.3.9: and to cause all to see what [is] the fellowship of the secret that hath been hid from the ages in God, who the all things did create by Jesus Christ,
texts.eph.3.10: that there might be made known now to the principalities and the authorities in the heavenly [places], through the assembly, the manifold wisdom of God,
texts.eph.3.11: according to a purpose of the ages, which He made in Christ Jesus our Lord,
texts.eph.3.12: in whom we have the freedom and the access in confidence through the faith of him,
texts.eph.3.13: wherefore, I ask [you] not to faint in my tribulations for you, which is your glory.
texts.eph.3.14: For this cause I bow my knees unto the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ,
texts.eph.3.15: of whom the whole family in the heavens and on earth is named,
texts.eph.3.16: that He may give to you, according to the riches of His glory, with might to be strengthened through His Spirit, in regard to the inner man,
texts.eph.3.17: that the Christ may dwell through the faith in your hearts, in love having been rooted and founded,
texts.eph.3.18: that ye may be in strength to comprehend, with all the saints, what [is] the breadth, and length, and depth, and height,
texts.eph.3.19: to know also the love of the Christ that is exceeding the knowledge, that ye may be filled -- to all the fulness of God;
texts.eph.3.20: and to Him who is able above all things to do exceeding abundantly what we ask or think, according to the power that is working in us,
texts.eph.3.21: to Him [is] the glory in the assembly in Christ Jesus, to all the generations of the age of the ages. Amen.
texts.eph.4.1: Call upon you, then, do I -- the prisoner of the Lord -- to walk worthily of the calling with which ye were called,
texts.eph.4.2: with all lowliness and meekness, with long-suffering, forbearing one another in love,
texts.eph.4.3: being diligent to keep the unity of the Spirit in the bond of the peace;
texts.eph.4.4: one body and one Spirit, according as also ye were called in one hope of your calling;
texts.eph.4.5: one Lord, one faith, one baptism,
texts.eph.4.6: one God and Father of all, who [is] over all, and through all, and in you all,
texts.eph.4.7: and to each one of you was given the grace, according to the measure of the gift of Christ,
texts.eph.4.8: wherefore, he saith, `Having gone up on high he led captive captivity, and gave gifts to men,' --
texts.eph.4.9: and that, he went up, what is it except that he also went down first to the lower parts of the earth?
texts.eph.4.10: he who went down is the same also who went up far above all the heavens, that He may fill all things --
texts.eph.4.11: and He gave some [as] apostles, and some [as] prophets, and some [as] proclaimers of good news, and some [as] shepherds and teachers,
texts.eph.4.12: unto the perfecting of the saints, for a work of ministration, for a building up of the body of the Christ,
texts.eph.4.13: till we may all come to the unity of the faith and of the recognition of the Son of God, to a perfect man, to a measure of stature of the fulness of the Christ,
texts.eph.4.14: that we may no more be babes, tossed and borne about by every wind of the teaching, in the sleight of men, in craftiness, unto the artifice of leading astray,
texts.eph.4.15: and, being true in love, we may increase to Him [in] all things, who is the head -- the Christ;
texts.eph.4.16: from whom the whole body, being fitly joined together and united, through the supply of every joint, according to the working in the measure of each single part, the increase of the body doth make for the building up of itself in love.
texts.eph.4.17: This, then, I say, and I testify in the Lord; ye are no more to walk, as also the other nations walk, in the vanity of their mind,
texts.eph.4.18: being darkened in the understanding, being alienated from the life of God, because of the ignorance that is in them, because of the hardness of their heart,
texts.eph.4.19: who, having ceased to feel, themselves did give up to the lasciviousness, for the working of all uncleanness in greediness;
texts.eph.4.20: and ye did not so learn the Christ,
texts.eph.4.21: if so be ye did hear him, and in him were taught, as truth is in Jesus;
texts.eph.4.22: ye are to put off concerning the former behaviour the old man, that is corrupt according to the desires of the deceit,
texts.eph.4.23: and to be renewed in the spirit of your mind,
